notes.title: New achievements
notes.content:
Added 20 new achievements.
A total of 20 levels and 40 achievements are available.
The level design has been partially changed.
New achievements are marked with the inscription S1, S2, S3,.. S20 they can be found by carefully studying the levels, some of the achievements are visible.
Part of the achievements you will have to look for on the levels exploring all the areas and using teleports to find the most hidden parts of the level.

notes.title: Added partial controller support
notes.content:
Added partial gamepad support!
To start the game, you will need a keyboard and mouse!
Use the mouse to adjust the music and effects!
In the game itself, you can use the gamepad to control the character, try using sticks and buttons.
You can turn, shoot and jump, as well as it is possible to move the character without turning it allows you to shoot and retreat (backward movement).

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Fixed and improved 1,2,3,4,5 levels.
Added new levels with doors and achievements.
8 new tracks.
Added 15 achievements and 15 levels!
A total of 20 levels and 20 achievements are available.
